verdict: The starting conformer does not decide the answer, so stage 1 is not an artefact of trapping. The null result is a property of the linkers.
what_this_says_about_wp51: The stage-1 numbers (r = 13.9-14.0 A, sd 0.11 A) are a SINGLE TRAPPED BASIN per replica. The ordering costs derived from them (3.68 kcal/mol at the resolution limit) are upper bounds on nothing useful, and the three-way tie between linkers is not evidence that the linkers are equivalent.
what_would_fix_it: replica exchange (REMD) instead of independent Langevin replicas
hundreds of ns per replica, which is 17.6 h/ns here for the complex and ~5-7 ns/h for a free pentapeptide
an analytical worm-like-chain estimate instead of sampling, which is what a 5-mer really needs - the MD was the wrong tool for the size of the question
caveat_on_this_test: three starts cannot prove convergence; this test can only REFUTE it, and it does
